title: Grateful Dead Live at Hofheinz Pavilion on 1972-11-19

ai_review.summary: Pretty good soundboard recording; reviewers note decent audio but give no specific show highlights.

No details about the performance, setlist, or individual musicians are provided, so the musical quality remains unassessed beyond this general approval.
